changes.result: Commit 526757a8 adds only crates/herder/src/mcp/resources.rs. ResourceUri parses and canonically formats herder://session|task|transcript|resource/{opaque-ref}; invalid encodings, noncanonical encodings, extra path/query/fragment, empty/control refs are rejected. ResourceReadPort and ResourceValue provide typed source boundaries for existing SessionSnapshot, rmcp GetTaskResult, TranscriptPage and canonical ResourceDescriptor; list/read projection returns pinned rmcp Resource/ListResourcesResult/ReadResourceResult. Four focused tests passed with temporary `pub mod resources;` in lib.rs, removed before commit. rustfmt +stable and git diff --check pass. Shared module registration and runtime consumer remain unproven.
